title: Tracing the value returned by add
description: You can compare a function's name and printed label with its actual expression.

steps.description: The function is named add, but its return expression is a - b. You can inspect that expression before following its caller.
main assigns 5 to a and 10 to b. The call passes those values into add and saves its result.

steps.question: Which number will result supply to printf?
steps.answer: It supplies -5 because the executed expression subtracts 10 from 5.

steps.description: You see The sum of 5 and 10 is -5. The output label says sum while the returned value comes from subtraction.
